notes.title: Turtle power
notes.notes:
🦕 Dino & Chill - Update Log 🦖


Hey dino lovers! We’ve been hard at work behind the scenes and are excited to drop a fresh update packed with improvements and new features. Here's what’s new:

✨ New Features & Improvements:

🔹 Revamped Dino name System
We've redesigned the name save for both new and retired dinosaurs. It’s now easier to rename your collection!

🎁 Daily Chest Added
Check in daily for a chance to win rewards! Prizes include gems, perks free purchases, and even... nothing (hey, it keeps things exciting 😉 and comes with a positive message).

💩 Dino Poo System Overhaul
We’ve rebalanced spawn rates for dino poo to improve gameplay flow and reduce clutter. It’s cleaner than ever—well, sort of....Added perk for Mr Turtle to follow your Dino pet around and clean up for you!

As always, thank you for chilling with us and helping our dino park grow! Got feedback or suggestions? Drop us a line on the forums or Discord!

🦖❤️ More balanced Dino spawn rate
We’ve rebalanced spawn rates for dino types so should be a little more balance but hey the spawns are random based on chance :)

Stay jurassic 🦖❤️
– The Dino & Chill Dev Team
